controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: USGS Voyager/Galileo mosaic on a 1 km grid; original detail varies from about 1 to 10 km per pixel. Gray grid marks documented no-data and its resampled boundary. Photographed terrain shading remains; globe lighting is approximate.
controls.summary: Source detail ranges from 1 to 10 km per pixel. Photographed shadows remain; the gray grid marks missing imagery.
controls.title: Global image mosaic

controls.label: Enhanced color
controls.description: USGS enhanced-color mosaic: near-infrared, green and violet color ratios combined with observed monochrome detail. USGS corrected broad limb darkening and matched image seams. Source color detail varies from 1.3 to 21 km per pixel. Interpolated polar color is withheld; observed monochrome remains where available. Gray grid marks missing imagery. Acquisition shading, seams and changes between mission dates can remain; globe lighting is approximate.
controls.summary: Infrared, green and violet ratios add color to monochrome detail. Interpolated polar color is withheld from this view.
controls.title: False-color mosaic

controls.label: Geology
controls.description: Fourteen base geologic units mapped from Voyager and Galileo observations. Colors distinguish interpreted plains, lava flows, patera floors and mountains. The separate diffuse-deposit overlay and structural linework are not shown. Gray grid marks unmapped or conflicting polygons; this view adds no measured relief.

legend.title: Geologic units
legend.meta: Symbols identify archived categories. Colors are chosen for this display.

controls.title: Global geologic map

controls.label: Spectral slope
controls.description: Slope from 477.5 to 495 nm, normalized at 495 nm, in published VLT/MUSE observations from July 2019. Sulfur materials affect this slope; it is not sulfur-dioxide abundance. Native two-degree samples remain visible. Nights retain differences and seams; gray grid marks missing or conservatively withheld edges. Absolute subpixel registration is unresolved.
controls.summary: Sulfur-sensitive slope from 2° samples with approximate registration. Gray grid marks missing or withheld data; joins between nights remain. Values do not measure sulfur abundance.
controls.title: Sulfur-sensitive visible spectral slope

controls.label: Visible absorption
controls.description: Published mean absorption around 560 nm after continuum removal. The 578–605 nm instrument gap is omitted. Sulfur-bearing materials can contribute, but the absorbing species is not uniquely identified. July 2019 observing nights retain seams and residual differences. Native two-degree samples, missing areas and withheld edges remain; this is not abundance.
controls.summary: A broad 520–660 nm absorption feature with uncertain chemical attribution. These 2° samples have approximate registration. Gray grid marks missing or withheld data; joins between nights remain.
controls.title: Continuum-relative visible absorption
